items.title: 31.8 Nuclear energy - fission aur fusion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nuclear and solar energy with Quick Check 31.5 and derived answers (PDF 228-230); the comparison table and fission figure are ours.

blocks.text: Fossil fuels aur environment par un ke harmful (nuqsan dene wale) effects parhte hue nuclear energy ke bare mein janna bhi zaruri hai. Nuclear energy aik promising (ummeed afza) source hai jo duniya ki barhti hui energy ki zaruratein poori karne mein madad de sakta hai. Nuclear energy woh energy hai jo atom ke nucleus se nikalti hai, ya to jab heavy (bhari) nuclei toot'te hain (fission) ya jab light (halke) nuclei aapas mein jurte hain (fusion). Yeh reactions chemical reactions ke muqable mein bohat hi zyada energy dete hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: 2011 mein Japan mein bare earthquake (zalzale) aur tsunami ki wajah se Fukushima mein nuclear reactors mein accidents (haadse) hue. Radioactive leaks (radioactive cheezein bahar nikalne) ki wajah se 150,000 se zyada logon ko wahan se nikalna para, aur duniya ko fikr hui ke disaster-prone regions (aafat wale ilaqon) mein nuclear plants kitne safe (mehfooz) hain.
